title: Local vision toolkit
description: On-demand command-line tools for agents: text search over image folders, silhouette compare, pose keypoints, point tracking in video, plus a Blender script for normal and curvature renders. Models run locally; needs about 12 GB of disk once set up and an NVIDIA GPU for useful speed.
postInstall: Vision: run `python ~/.agents/tools/vision/vision.py setup` once to create its virtual environment; models download on first use. The Blender script ~/.agents/tools/vision/surface_views.py needs no setup.
